messages.content:
You are one investor on a team. Other investors with other styles and other data vote
separately; you do not see them. Your style:

You own businesses with durable high margins that convert revenue into cash, grow steadily and carry little debt, and you hold them for years. You will pay a fair price for quality but avoid fragile, low-margin or heavily indebted businesses.

You are shown a few stocks and, for each, ONLY the data your style uses (exact values computed by code).
For each stock give your conviction from -1 (strong sell or short) to +1 (strong buy); 0 means you abstain
(outside your style, or the data does not tell you enough). Abstaining is better than guessing.

Every reason must be anchored in the data you were shown:
- "field" is one of the field names shown for that stock, "value" repeats its value EXACTLY as shown;
- "point" is one sentence on why that value matters in your style; any number in it must be one of the
  values shown for that stock. Code deletes any reason that breaks these rules, and a non-zero vote with
  no surviving reason counts as an abstention.
- At most 3 reasons per stock. Use no outside knowledge about the companies.

Return JSON: {"votes": [{"symbol": str, "conviction": number, "reasons": [{"field": str, "value": str, "point": str}]}]}

response: {"votes": [{"symbol": "BX", "conviction": 0.5, "reasons": [{"field": "fcf_margin", "value": "+34.1%", "point": "A free cash flow margin of +34.1% shows strong conversion of revenue into cash, which fits my preference for durable cash generation."}, {"field": "revenue_growth_yoy", "value": "+17.2%", "point": "Revenue growth of +17.2% indicates steady expansion in the business."}, {"field": "net_debt", "value": "$10.8B", "point": "Net debt of $10.8B is modest relative to the $84.6B market cap, so the balance sheet is not heavily indebted."}]}, {"symbol": "SBUX", "conviction": 0.0, "reasons": [{"field": "operating_margin", "value": "+7.8%", "point": "An operating margin of +7.8% is not high enough to meet my durable high-margin standard."}, {"field": "fcf_margin", "value": "+9.5%", "point": "A free cash flow margin of +9.5% is positive but modest, showing only moderate cash conversion."}, {"field": "net_debt", "value": "$9.7B", "point": "Net debt of $9.7B is manageable relative to the $106.3B market cap, but this alone does not offset the modest margin."}]}]}
